data.name: SuppliesRow
data.comment: Row on the Supplies page that opens the shelf photos.

data.name: SuppliesNone
data.value: A photo of a shelf with a dot on each plant
data.comment: Line under Shelf photos on the Supplies page when there are none. Says what a shelf photo is for.

data.name: SuppliesCount_One
data.comment: Line under Shelf photos on the Supplies page. {0} is how many there are.

data.name: SuppliesCount_Other
data.comment: Line under Shelf photos on the Supplies page. {0} is how many there are.

data.name: ListPageTitle
data.comment: Title of the Shelf photos page in the browser tab.

data.name: ListTitle
data.comment: Heading of the Shelf photos page.

data.name: ListIntro
data.value: Photos of a shelf or a room, with a dot on each plant. Tap a dot to see which plant it is. A place keeps its photos, so you can see how a shelf changed.
data.comment: Lead line under the heading of the Shelf photos page.

data.name: AddPhoto
data.comment: Button on the Shelf photos page that opens the sheet for a new shelf photo.

data.name: ShowAll
data.comment: Link on the Shelf photos page when it shows one place only. Shows the photos of every place.

data.name: PlaceRemoved
data.comment: Heading over shelf photos whose room or spot was removed.

data.name: TileMarked_One
data.comment: Under a shelf photo in the list. {0} is how many plants are marked on it.

data.name: TileMarked_Other
data.comment: Under a shelf photo in the list. {0} is how many plants are marked on it.

data.name: TileNoneMarked
data.comment: Under a shelf photo in the list when no plant is marked on it.

data.name: TileLabel
data.comment: Name of a shelf photo for screen readers. {0} is the day it was taken.

data.name: EmptyAll
data.value: A shelf photo is a picture of a shelf or a room with a dot on each plant, so you can see which is which and how the shelf changed.
data.comment: Empty state on the Shelf photos page. Says what a shelf photo is for.

data.name: EmptyPlace
data.value: No shelf photos of this place yet. A shelf photo is a picture of it with a dot on each plant.
data.comment: Empty state on the Shelf photos page when it shows one place.

data.name: AddTitle
data.comment: Title of the sheet where a shelf photo is added.

data.name: AddPlaceLabel
data.comment: Label over the choice of room or spot in the sheet where a shelf photo is added.

data.name: AddPlaceHint
data.value: Pick the room or spot the photo is of first.
data.comment: Shown in the add sheet until a room or spot is picked.

data.name: AddCamera
data.comment: Button in the add sheet that opens the camera.

data.name: AddGallery
data.comment: Button in the add sheet that opens the gallery. More than one photo can be picked.

data.name: AddSaving
data.comment: Shown in the add sheet while the photos are saved.

data.name: PhotoPageTitle
data.comment: Title of a shelf photo's page in the browser tab.

data.name: BackToList
data.comment: Back link at the top of a shelf photo's page.

data.name: Gone
data.value: This shelf photo isn't here any more.
data.comment: Shown on a shelf photo's page when the photo was deleted, on this device or another.

data.name: PhotoAlt
data.comment: Description of the photo for screen readers. {0} is the room or spot.

data.name: ShowNames
data.comment: Switch under a shelf photo that shows the name of every marked plant at once.

data.name: LabelOpen
data.comment: Link in the small label beside a dot. Opens the plant's page.

data.name: LabelRemove
data.comment: Button in the small label beside a dot while marking. Removes the mark. The plant is not touched.

data.name: MarkPlants
data.comment: Button on a shelf photo's page that starts marking plants in the photo.

data.name: MarkHint
data.value: Tap a plant in the photo
data.comment: Shown in the bar at the bottom of a shelf photo's page while marking.

data.name: MarkedHeading
data.comment: Heading over the list of plants marked on a shelf photo.

data.name: NoneMarked
data.comment: Shown under a shelf photo when no plant is marked on it.

data.name: NoneMarkedHint
data.value: Tap Mark plants, then tap each plant in the photo.
data.comment: Under "No plants marked yet". Mark plants is the name of a button.

data.name: PickTitle
data.comment: Title of the sheet that opens when a spot in a shelf photo is tapped while marking.

data.name: PickSearch
data.comment: Placeholder and label of the search field in that sheet.

data.name: PickNone
data.value: No plants or cuttings to pick from.
data.comment: Shown in that sheet when nothing is left to pick, or nothing matches the search.

data.name: PickMore
data.value: Showing the first {0}. Type to narrow it down.
data.comment: Shown at the end of the long list in that sheet. {0} is how many are shown.

data.name: DeletePhoto
data.comment: Link at the bottom of a shelf photo's page.

data.name: DeleteConfirm
data.value: Delete this photo? The marks on it go with it. The plants aren't affected.
data.comment: Asked before a shelf photo is deleted.

data.name: HistoryLabel
data.comment: Heading of an entry on a plant's history that shows it in a shelf photo.

data.name: HistoryOpen
data.comment: Name of the link on that entry for screen readers. {0} is the day the photo was taken.

data.name: PlantsLinkCount
data.comment: Quiet link on the Plants page when the list is filtered on a room or spot. {0} is how many shelf photos it has.

data.name: PlantsLinkNone
data.value: Take a photo of this place
data.comment: Quiet link on the Plants page when the list is filtered on a room or spot that has no shelf photos.
